"$ ༄༅// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ karma pak+shi stod nas byon// gsung yi ge drug ma'i nyi ma shar// 'di 'don mkhan yod na da res 'don// gling bzhi'i nyi ma shar lags kyang*// mig med long bas mthong ba med// da res nyi ma nub nas shar// sangs rgyas bstan pa nub nas byung*// mig med long ba'i dpal du shar// ltos shig ltos shig da res ltos// da res mthong ba don ldan yin// la stod nas byon pa'i lam du gsungs// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma rin po che// nga bla ma dang 'bral ba med par 'grogs// bla ma la gsol ba yang yang du 'debs// drin can bla ma yis byin gyis brlobs// 'bral med ting 'dzin cig zas su zos// 'bral med ting 'dzin cig gos su gon// 'bral med ting 'dzin cig nyams su blangs// gos srab mthug gnyis la khyad par med// gos su gtum mo'i bde drod gon// rnam shes rlung gi rta pho bzhon// 'og rta yod med khyad par med// gsung ngo*// oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ lhan la nyam chung lha 'dre rnams// bar chad rtsom du byung ba la// karma pak+shi bdag nyid ni// rta rgod 'phags pas de'u skyur// lhan lha nyag chung lha 'dre rnams// bar chad rtsom gyi 'dug pa las// phyag na rdo rje las skyes 'tsho// zhal cig phyag gnyis g.yas pa ni// g.yon pa sdig 'dzub rdo rje g.yas// lhan lha nyag chung lha 'dre rnams// zil gyis mnan cing dbang du bsdus// gzhan snang kha dog sngon por mthong*// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad rdo rje 'chang*// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad tai lo la// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad nā ro pa// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad lho brag pa// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad gung thang pa// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad sgam po pa// 'gro drug=

byin gyis= 'gro ba 'dren mdzad dus gsum mkhyen// 'gro drug= byin gyis= 'gro ba 'dren mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro drug sems= byin gyis brlab= 'gro ba 'dren mdzad spong brag pa// 'gro drug= byin gyis = /'gro ba 'dren mdzad karma ma pa// 'gro drug= byin gyis= 'gro ba 'dren mdzad u rgyan pa// 'gro drug sems= byin gyis= 'gro ba 'dren mdzad chos kyi rje// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa 'di 'brug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum la bka' brgyud rnams zhal gzigs pa'i dus su mdzad/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi che ba ston// rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rtogs ldan rnams kyi che ba bton// tai lo pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ grub thob rnams kyi che ba bton// nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par= lo ts+tsha rnams kyi che ba bton// lho brag pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug= byin gyis= ras pa rnams kyi che ba bton// mi la mchog la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug= byin gyis= phyag rgya chen po'i che ba bton// sgam po ba la gso la ba 'debs// 'gro drug= byin gyis= zhwa nag can gyi che ba bton// dus gsum mkhyen pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug = byin gyis= mkhas pa rnams kyi che ba bton// ras chen pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug= /byin gyis= bla ma rnams kyi che ba bton// spong brag pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug= byin gyis= dgon pa phyogs med 'debs pa'i mi// ri khrod rnams kyi che ba bton// karma ma pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug=

byin gyis= sems dpa' rnams kyi che ba bton// rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug= sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'di shangs pa'i bskor ba pa mang byung dus gsungs so// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ mtshur phu'i dgon pa 'di nyid ni// chu bo brgya 'dus kyi mgo bo 'dra// grub thob rnams kyi 'dus sa yod// skal ldan rnams kyi smin sa yod// 'gro drug byang chub thob pa yod// rgyab ri pad ma spungs pa 'dra// sa ra ha yis byin gyis brlabs// mdun ri yid bzhin nor bu 'dra// sgrol ma sngon mos byin gyis rlob// phu ni gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'dra// rdo rje 'chang gis byin gyis brlabs// mda' ni pad ma kha gyes 'dra// ma mgon gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs// lung pa byang chub rgyud lam 'dra// shākya thub pas byin gyis brlabs// de 'dra'i dben gnas mtshur phu de// dag pa rnams kyi bsgom sa yin// ma dag pa yi grong yul yin// de ltar kun gyi go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ rang byung rdo rje'i gtam 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa rnams la zlo ba/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ bdud dang lha 'dre mang po'i bar chad 'byung ba'i dogs yod pa'i phyir na/ thams cad kyis thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgyal mtsho bsgoms shig /de ltar go bar gyis la ma ṇi pad me drongs/ sems can rnams la sbyin par thong*/ tshogs gnyis bsags na sgrib gnyis byang ba yin pas kun gyis go bar mdzod/ bkra shis dpa' 'bar rab 'bar snying rje che 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang gi lung*/ rang byung rdo rje'i gtam/ 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa la zlo ba/ da lta'i dus 'dir sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las grol bar bya ba'i phyir/

thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'di kun gyis bsgoms shing*/ ma ṇi pad me 'di bgrangs na/ sdug bsngal thams cad las grol thar zhing/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir na/ de ltar kun gyis go bar gyis// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ dben gnas chen mo phug mo che// dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gnas// ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sa// rgyab ri mchod rten brtsegs pa 'dra// mdun ri glang chen nyal ba 'dra// phu ni rin chen spungs pa 'dra// mda' ni phyag rgya bsnol ba 'dra// lung pa byang chub rgyun lam 'dra// de 'dra'i dben gnas phug mo che// bsgom chen rnams kyi bsgom sa yin// ri pa rnams kyi 'dus sa yin// de ltar kun gyis go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐// 'gro don thugs rje chen pos byed// blo chung rnams la rag ma lus// bar chad stong pa nyid kyis sel// yi dam lha la rag ma lus// pho nya steng gi lha yis byed// snyan sgrogs mi la rag ma lus// sgo bsrungs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro byed// the rang rnams la rag ma lus// phyogs mtshams khro bo bcu yis bsrung*// sdig can mi la rag ma lus// rag ma lus pa lnga ldan pa// sku lnga'i ye shes mtshon pa yin// mtshon bya mtshon byed med pa yin// yi dam lha tshogs grub pa yin// snang yul thams cad grub ma yin// ma grub ma 'dres so sor gsal// ma grub med par grub pa yin// rtogs rgyu med pa rtogs pa yin// don dam blo las 'das pa yin// gnyis med ye shes rtogs pa yin// kun khyab sems can 'dren pa yin// bar chad bdud rnams sel ba yin// kun gyi bag chags 'phyag byed pa// ma bsgribs don dam rtogs pa yin// rtsa ba cig bsdus bris pa yin// bsdu rgyu med pa'i ngang yin pas// thams cad khrol la lhod kyis klod// rtog pa kun khyab rang byung ye shes rgyal ba'i rgyal du shog

/sbrul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la gsungs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'khor ba'i sems can snying re rje// sems can ma dag gdul bya rnams// myur du drongs shig spyan ras gzigs// don dam chos sku blo las 'das// 'dzin med rang grol chen po yin// don rtogs bka' brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// kun khyab rgyal ba'i dgongs pa la// blo las 'das shing brjod du med// kun rdzob sems can snang ba la// rtogs shing yod pa 'dra bar snang*// rtogs bya rtogs byed med pa yin// go bar gyis shig bsgom chen rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar don rtogs rgyal ba'i rgyal du shog sbrul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la'o// oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// stong gsum 'jig rten 'di nyid ni// ma ṇi'i 'brug sgra rgyun mi chad// skal ldan rnams la byin gyis rlobs// zhing khams rnam dag 'di nyid du// zab mo'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad// phyag chen rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs dbang la// 'gro drug dad pas gsol 'debs na// bde chen gnas su drangs su gsol// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis// ma ṇi gyer dang*/ ngan song gnas nas thon pa yin// rang byung rdo rjes rta lo la bkra shis gsar mar gsungs so// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ chos sku mnyam med nam mkha' la// longs sku ye shes sprin tshogs 'khrigs// sprul sku bde chen char rgyun byung*// sems can gti mug rmongs pa la// bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyid// mnyam par rtogs par mdzad pa yi// rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bde chen ye shes nam mkha' la// mnyam nyid ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs// shes rab chen po'i char rgyun gyis// sems can bar do thams cad la// ye shes chen po rtogs byed pa'i// tai lo pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/

des 'gre'o /rtogs pa 'dzin med nam mkha' la// ye shes rtogs pa'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// ngar 'dzin med pa'i char rgyun byung*// byol song la sogs 'gro ba la// gnyis med ye shes rtogs mdzad pa'i// nā ro pa la= 'gro drug= byin gyis= bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' la// shes rab chen po'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// bdud rtsi chen po'i char rgyun 'bebs// thams cad sems nyid rtogs mdzad pa'i// lho brag pa la= 'gro drug= byin gyis= stong pa'i 'od gsal nam mkha' la// 'od gsal ba yi sprin tshogs 'khrigs// mdzad pa 'phrin las char rgyun byung*// thams cad stong nyid rtogs mdzad pa'i// gung thang pa la gsol= 'gro drug= byin gyis= rdzogs pa chen po'i nam mkha' la// 'dzin pa med pa'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// ye shes chen po'i char rgyun babs// 'gro drug bde bar rol mdzad pa'i// sgam po ba la= 'gro drug= byin gyis brlab= stong pa phyag chen nam mkha' la// bde ba chen po'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// bar do'i sdug bsngal sel ba yi// mnyam pa nyid kyi char rgyun byung*// gnyis med bde bar 'dren mdzad pa'i// dus gsum mkhyen la= 'gro drug= byin gyis= dbyings kyi bde chen nam mkha' la// 'char 'gag med pa'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// shugs byung chen po'i char rgyun byung*// thams cad sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i// ras chen pa la= 'gro drug= byin gyis= gsal stong 'dzin med nam mkha' la// zhen pa med pa'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// rang snang stong pa'i char rgyun byung*// sems can bde bar 'khod pa yi// spom brag pa la gsol= 'gro drug= byin gyis= gsal stong 'gag med nam mkha' la// zhen med 'dzin med sprin tshogs 'khrigs// sems can dug sel char rgyun byung*// 'gro drug thams cad 'dren mdzad pa'i// karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// bka' brgyud rnams la gsol btab pas// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*// kun kyang phyag chen rtogs par shog

/bkra shis gsar mar rta lo la gsungs so// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro drug kun la byin gyis brlobs// 'khor ba'i sems can sdug re bsngal// nyon mongs thams cad bsal nas kyang*// bde ba'i gnas su drangs su gsol// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog 'di gong gi dus der gsungs so// lo ki shwa ri la na mo/ bod kyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad kyang*/ thugs rje chen po nyid kyi sprul pas gang zhing*/ sems can re re'i drung na/ thugs rje chen po re re bzhugs pa'i phyir na/ thams cad kun kyis thugs rje chen po bsgoms zhing*/ ma ṇi pad me bgrangs na/ 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par yin pas/ kun gyis thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs la/ dad pa dang mus gus khyad par can gyis shig bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// bar chad bdud du langs na yang*// tshad med thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyis// thams cad bde la 'khod par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho thugs rje can// lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang*// kun kyang dgra ru langs na yang*// ye shes chen po'i thugs rje yis// thams cad snying rje ldan par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes spyan// ma rig mu na pa 'thibs gyur na// ye shes chen po'i mar me yis// thams cad gsal ba nyid du shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho shes rab spyan// rang rig shes rab 'thibs gyur na// mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i shes rab kyis// kun kyang shes rab ldan par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho byams pa can// rang rig spro nyid thung gyur na// snying rje chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// thams cad byams pa ldan par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho brtson 'grus can// rang rig le los g.yel gyur na// brtson 'grus chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// thams cad brtson 'grus ldan par shog

/rgyal ba rgyal mtsho thams cad kyis// ma rig mun pa bsal nas kyang*// ye shes bde ba'i lam 'dren shog /rin po che rang byung rdo rjes rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i smon lam btab pa'o// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// ma ṇi thams cad kun gyis bgrangs shing bzlas na/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i 'dam las rgyal bar gyur pa yin pas na/ thams cad kun gyis drongs shig rgyal ba rgya mtsho rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*// dmyal ba'i gnas na snying re rje// myur du drongs shig spyan ras gzigs// dbyer med sems kyi snang ngo la// rang rig sems kyi cho 'phrul du// sangs rgyas gnas su drangs su gsol// thugs rje can gyi zhing khams su// myur du bla med phyin nas kyang*// brtse ba chen po'i ye shes kyis// 'gro drug myur du 'dren par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ mnyam nyid dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// bdag gzhan 'gro don lhun grub pa'i// rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings nyid nas// spros pa'i mtha' bral chos kyi sku// tai lo pa la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bde ba chen po'i dbyings nyid nas// thugs rjes gzhan don sku sprul pa'i// nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// skyes mchog skyes bu dam pa'i mchog /bla med 'gran zla bral ba'i mchog /lho brag pa la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// spros bral dag pa'i dbyings nyid nas// chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor pa// gung thang pa la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// 'gro don shugs las 'byung pa yi// sgam po ba la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// seng ge sgra yi rnam par 'phrul// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// dus gsum mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// snying po mthar thug rtogs pa'i ngang*// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i// 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// don dam phyag chen mthong ba yi// mkha' 'gros byin brlabs rnal 'byor pa// spong brag pa la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bka' rgyud bla ma thams cad la// gsol ba btab pa'i byin brlabs kyis// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// phyag rgya chen po thob par shog

/mtshur phur lug lo la gsungs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bde chen dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// snyigs ma'i dus su sprul pa'i sku// bde chen yang dag rdzogs pa yi// don dam yongs rdzogs karma pa// 'gran gyi do med rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// kun gyi mchog gyur rin chen gyi// bstod pa cung zhig bkod par bya// spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// bde chen ye shes ngo sprod cing*// 'khor ba'i log rtog ma lus kun// 'joms mdzad bla ma rin po che/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// sa ra ha yi rnam 'phrul nyid// rdzogs chen ye shes klong du gyur// theg pa chung ngu'i sems can rnams// bde chen lam la 'jug mdzad pa'i// rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam par 'phrul// snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba'i mgon// kun gyi mchog gyur rin po che// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen la/ gsol ba 'di btab bsod nams kyis// bde chen ye shes thob par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po'i rgyud las/ thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i grangs dang mnyam par 'phrul zhing*/ sems can re re'i tsa na yang thugs rje chen po re re bzhugs pa yin pa'i phyir na/ thugs rje chen po la dad cing ma ṇi 'dren pa thams cad kyis 'di ltar du bgrang bar bya'o// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can// khams gsum log rtog sna tshogs la// ma lus byed pa'i sems can rnams// bde ba'i gnas su drang du gsol// spyan ras gzig dbang thugs rje'i bdag /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// 'khor ba'i gnas nas drangs nas kyang*// bde ba'i gnas su khrid mdzad gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag

/khams gsum sems can ma lus pa dang// nyon mongs gang gi dbang gyur pa'i// log par rtog pa'i sems can rnams// bde ba'i lam du drang du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /khams gsum sems can thams cad nyid/ 'khor ba'i gnas nas drangs nas kyang*// bde ba'i gnas su khrid mdzad gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// nyon mongs gang gi dbang gyur pa// log par rtogs pa'i sems can rnams// bde ba'i gnas su drang du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// dug lnga rags par gyur pa la// snying rje chen po'i ye shes kyis// ye shes lnga ru bsgyur du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje bdag /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// 'thab rtsod log par byed pa rnams// thams cad thugs rjes gzigs nas kyang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i sa thob shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /sku mdog dkar ba'i rnam dag ni// rnam par snang mdzad ngo bor grub// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /rang bzhin stong pa thugs chud pas// rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor grub// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan par ni// rin chen 'byung ldan ngo bor gyur// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can// pad ma dkar po 'dzin pas ni// snang ba mtha' yas ngo bor grub// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /g.yas na phreng ba bsnams pa ni// don yod grub pa'i ngo bo nyid// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzod du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag

oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// chos sku'i bdag nyid kun du bzang*// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// longs sku'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sprul sku shākya thub pa la// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// sku gsum dbyer med chos kyi rje// seng ge sgra la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// chos sku'i mchog gyur bla ma rje// rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// longs sku'i mchog gyur bla ma rje// spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sprul sku'i mchog gyur bla ma rje// shākya thub la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsum mchog gyur bla ma rje// 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// byang chub sems kyi 'phrin las kyis// spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlabs kyis// 'gro drug sems can bde ba la// myur du 'khod par mdzad du gsol// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /spre'u lo la mtshur phu'i dben gnas khyung rdzong du gsungs so// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rnam 'phrul spyan ras gzigs dbang la// bdag ni gus pas gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// bde ba'i gnas su drang du gsol// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// nam mkha'i mthong la yar bltas pas// 'od gsal zung 'jug phyag rgya che// mtha' dbus med pa klong du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// ri bo che la phar ltas pas// lhun gyis grub pa 'dus ma byas// g.yo 'gul med pa klong du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// rgya mtsho che la phar bltas pas// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bde ba chen po mngon du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pas// sgrub gnas pad ma khyung rdzong du// nyams la shar nas blangs pa yin// skal ldan rnams kyis go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i brgyan du shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grub thob rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// phyag rgya chen po'i don cig rtogs// rtogs rgyu med pa'i don cig yin// ma bcos gnyug ma mngon du gyur// bcos rgyu med pa'i don cig rtogs// bde ba chen po'i ngo bo yin// che chung med pa mngon du gyur// mthon dman med pa'i don cig rtogs// nyon mongs med pa'i don cig rtogs// dug lnga mi 'jigs mngon du gyur// ngo bo gsum gyi dbyangs chung 'di// sgrub gnas bkra shis khyung rdzong du// nyams la shar nas blangs pa lags// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /spre'u lo la khyung rdzong du gsungs so// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// yid la mchog gi byin gyis rlobs// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje ni// lta sgom spyod gsum 'bras bu bzhi// klong du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor bdag

/lta ba lta rgyu med pa la// spros dang bral ba'i sems nyid 'di// rang grol rang gsal mngon du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// sgom pa bsgom rgyu med pa la// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo nyid// spros dang bral ba mngon du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// spyod pa spyod rgyu med pa la// 'dzin med rang sar grol ba yi// mnyam rjes med pa mngon du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// 'bras bu re dogs med pa la// bde chen ye shes mngon du gyur// da yong rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// bsam gyis mi khyab mthar thug don// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po ni// 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi// rgyud la de nyid thob par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /spre'u lo la khyung rdzong du gsungs so// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ gzhi ni ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*// lam ni sa bcu pha rol bcu// 'bras bu ma yengs phyag chen dang*// de lta bu'i gdams ngag de// 'bral med cig tu nyams su long*// lta ba phyogs ris med pa la// bsgom pa yengs su med pa yin// spyod pa dgag sgrub med pa yin// de lta bu yi gdams ngag de// 'bral med cig tu nyams su long*// chos sku brjod las 'das pa la// longs sku'i tshogs de kun la khyab// sprul sku sems can 'gro don mdzad// de lta bu yi gdams ngag de// 'bral med cig tu nyams su long*// de gsum dbyer med ngo bo de// sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang la zhog /sgyu ma dmigs su med pa yi// 'od gsal zung 'jug ngo bo'i don// de lta bu yi bral med de// thams cad rdzogs pa'i pha rol na// 'od gsal zung 'jug phyag rgya che// mtha' bral gnyug ma chos sku'i ngang*// ye nas rdzogs pa'i phyag chen nyid// de lta bu yi gdams ngag de/ 'bral med cig tu nyams su long// khyung rdzong du gsungs/
